SamenvattingStep into a dynamic role as a Production Operator B and be at the heart of our production, where your skills keep everything running smoothly and contribute directly to delivering fresh, high-quality products every day. Good work!Over de functieThe production Operator B ensures optimal performance of assigned production lines, producing products that meet both quality and quantity standards. This role involves setting up, monitoring, and maintaining machines, while following safety and quality regulations. You will also support team members and contribute to continuous improvement in a dynamic production environment.
Your responsibilities are:
- Set up and adjust machines to required production parameters
- Monitor production progress, manage orders, and maintain accurate process records
- Ensure product quality through inspections, metal detection, and process control
- Maintain order, and safety on the production lines (5S standards)
- Support and guide team members, escalating deviations to supervisors

Working hours:
- Our warehouses operate 24/7, so the work schedule includes weekend shifts as well as morning, afternoon, and night shifts.

Shift start times vary depending on the shift and the team. For example, a morning shift may start at 06:00, 08:00, or 10:00.

jobs.description:
As a warehouse worker at UPS Amsterdam, you are the key link in the logistics process. You sort packages, load and unload trucks, and make sure everything ends up in the right place. You work in a team where cooperation and clear communication matter. Your working hours are between 15:00 and 20:00, four days a week. Your day starts with a short briefing, then you get to work processing incoming goods. You unpack boxes, scan barcodes, and place packages on the right carts. Sometimes, you have to lift heavy boxes, so you are physically active. Safety always comes first: you follow instructions closely and keep your workspace tidy. At the end of the shift, you and your colleagues make sure the warehouse is clean again. In this role, you make a real difference by ensuring everyone gets their package on time.

Who are you? You like to be active and are not afraid to get things done. You work accurately because you know correct delivery is important. You are reliable, keep your agreements, and work well with others. Safe working is natural to you. You do not need specific experience, but you are motivated to learn. You live within 20 km of Zaandam and speak Dutch or English.
